title: Rice Kanji | Homemade Probiotics
description: A South Indian fermented rice and curd porridge, tempered with mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves and onion — a traditional homemade probiotic breakfast.

vegetarian.notes: Entire dish is vegetarian as written — rice, curds, and a standard tadka. No swaps needed.

steps.title: Soak rice overnight
steps.text: Soak 1/2 cup cooked rice in 1/2 cup water in a clay pot for about 10-12 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Blend fermented rice
steps.text: Next day, transfer fermented rice to a blender and blend to a smooth paste.

steps.title: Transfer to bowl
steps.text: Transfer blended rice into a mixing bowl.

steps.title: Whisk in curds
steps.text: Whisk 1/4 cup of homemade curds and add to rice paste and stir well. Preferably add slightly sour curds as it tastes more good.

steps.title: Season with salt
steps.text: Now add salt to taste and mix well.

steps.title: Fry tempering spices
steps.text: In a season pan / tadka pan, heat coconut oil, add mustard seeds, jeera seeds, urad dal, chopped curry leaves, chopped green chillies and fry well.

steps.title: Fry onions
steps.text: Add chopped onions and fry till it turns light brown. Turn off the stove.

steps.title: Add ginger and hing
steps.text: Now add in grated ginger, hing and mix well.

steps.title: Pour tempering over kanji
steps.text: Pour temper over the prepared rice kanji.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.text: Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve.

sourceNotes: Source lists prepTime 7min and cookTime 3min (totalTime 10min), but the recipe requires soaking cooked rice for 10-12 hours (overnight) before blending — the published totalTime appears to omit this unattended fermentation period. totalTimeMin here reflects active prep/cook (10 min) plus an 11-hour fermentation estimate. No skin-on meat, lamb, or Worcestershire involved — standing household constraints don't apply to this recipe. Read from the page's structured recipe data.
